$comment: Legion YARA engine configuration. This file is compiled into the binary as a default; a copy is written to <data_dir>/yara_config.json on first run and may be edited there to override. Per-OS rule sets are assembled from `rule_files`, fetched dynamically from `rules_repo` and cached under <data_dir>/rules/<os>/, falling back to the rules bundled in the binary when offline. When `scan_all_drives` is true the YARA engine scans every fixed drive/mount on the host (skipping removable/network media and OS pseudo-filesystems) instead of only `scan_paths`; set it false to restrict scanning to the per-OS `scan_paths` below.
